verdict.rationale: Azure documents general fine-grained RBAC and Managed Identities that eliminate credential management (azure-docs-10, azure-docs-11, azure-docs-12), which are generic building blocks that could underpin scoped, non-escalating credentials for an agent, but none of the evidence documents an agent-specific pattern (e.g., short-lived scoped tokens issued to an AI agent, workload identity federation for agents, or explicit non-escalation guarantees). Missing for 10: agent-specific credential-issuance docs, explicit temporary/short-lived token scoping guidance, documented non-escalation guarantees tailored to AI agents.
